title: Core: FLA import/export preserves all document properties
description: Round-trip serialization test that all DocumentProperties fields survive saveFla/loadFla: frameRate, width, height, backgroundColor, rulerUnits, grid.showGrid, grid.gridWidth, grid.gridHeight, grid.gridColor, guides (with orientation and position), snapToObjects, snapToPixels, snapToGuides. Tests in packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/docprops-roundtrip.test.ts.
